title: PR #123: audit: triage duplicate code across active repositories
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose
Record a fail-closed first-pass audit of duplicate-looking code across the active A-TownChain-Okosystems repositories and define the evidence gate for safe removals.

## What this PR does
- Records the 26 non-archived repository inventory and explicitly protects the 7 archived repositories.
- Classifies duplicate-looking canonical/subtree snapshot paths, migrated legacy implementations, and likely stale/divergent code.
- Preserves SSOT ownership, references, build/release evidence, archive history, and exact-SHA verification requirements.
- States explicitly that this is a targeted search/triage pass, not an exhaustive file-hash census.

## Important limits
- No source code is deleted in this PR.
- Safe deletions proven: 0. The current evidence is insufficient to prove that any candidate can be removed without breaking subtree sync, consumers, tests, CI, release packaging, or audit provenance.
- Follow-up owning-repository PRs must include exact 40-character SHAs, file hashes/diffs, reference analysis, and exact-head test/build evidence.

## Governance
Draft only. No merge, no auto-merge, no source implementation changes, no weakened CI gates. Archived repositories remain untouched.
